parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

>  If the call does not return all result entries, the value of the NextToken parameter is returned. By default, 200 rows are returned. You can call this operation again and set the value of the parameter to the value of the parameter that is returned in the last call to implement paged query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the resource.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~601478~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
A list of resource IDs for which you want to query tags. You can enter a maximum of 50 resource IDs.

Enter multiple resource IDs in the `["ResourceId. 1","ResourceId. 2",...]` format.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The type of resource whose tags you want to query. Valid value:

*   key
*   secret

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: A list of tags that you want to query. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun kms list-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --resource-type key --resource-id key-hzz62f1cb66fa42qo0000 --tag Value=true Key=disk-encryption --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun kms ListTagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'key-hzz62f1cb66fa42qo0000' --Tag.1.Key 'disk-encryption' --NextToken caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a4883 --Tag.1.Value true --ResourceType key --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
